title: Taipei Transit Radar
mascotLines: Calories assume 60 kg, whoever is actually commuting.
GitHub pauses schedules after 60 quiet days, so the bus data waits for someone to click.
imageCaptions: Desktop: NTNU to Neihu Science Park, with bus 235 then the Wenhu line recommended
On a phone: Taipei Main Station to Taipei 101, 23 minutes on the Tamsui–Xinyi line
Near Ximen station: the closest MRT stations and live bus arrivals at each stop
The 2016 hackathon version on an iPhone: one MRT trip with fare, times and distance
why: Team 3 built it at the 2016 IISI hackathon around one everyday question: how should someone in Taipei get to work without a car or scooter? The 2026 rewrite replaced Google Directions with government open data that needs no key, because a static site has nowhere to hide one.
gains: Useful before leaving the house in Greater Taipei: five ways to get there side by side, with the wait, arrival time, fare and calories. The calories assume a 60 kg traveller, as in 2016, whoever is actually travelling.
lessons: TDX, the national transport data service, now refuses requests without a key and allows guests about 20 a day per IP, which rules it out for a static site.
When a bus won't come, the live feed sends a code instead of a time: last bus gone, no service today, or skipped for traffic control. Those routes drop out.
GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days without repo activity, so the weekly bus-data rebuild can stop until someone presses Run workflow.
subtitle: Compare a trip before you take it
description: Walking, bus, MRT or YouBike? Compare travel time and fares on one map, with live bus arrivals and bike availability.
longDescription: A 2026 React rewrite of a team project from the 2016 IISI hackathon. Compare walking, bus, MRT, mixed transit and YouBike routes around Greater Taipei, including estimated fares and live arrival information. Original work by the hackathon team is credited in the repository.
features: Compare five travel options on one map
Live bus arrivals and YouBike availability
Sort routes by time, fare or walking distance
Share a route through its URL
